title: Velvet-Camellia Chicken Stir Fry
description: A simple and delicious stir fry recipe using velvet and camellia oil, perfect for a quick weeknight dinner.
instructions: 1. In a small bowl, whisk together velvet, soy sauce, and oyster sauce (if using). Add the chicken and marinate for at least 15 minutes.
2. Heat 1 tablespoon of camellia oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
3. Add the chicken to the wok and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes.
4. Remove the chicken from the wok and set aside.
5. In the same wok, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of camellia oil.
6. Add the garlic and ginger to the wok and stir-fry until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
7. Add the bell peppers and snow peas to the wok and stir-fry until tender-crisp, about 2-3 minutes.
8. Return the chicken to the wok and stir in the velvet marinade.
9. Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the sauce has thickened.
10. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
